name: kb-library-team
description: A 7-member expert team for knowledge-base management across the full lifecycle: ingest, classification, maturity promotion, indexing, grounded Q&A, quality inspection, archiving and metrics.

displayDescription.zh: 7人专家团队覆盖采集分类晋级索引问答巡检归档度量，把散落的资料整理成随问随答的知识库。
displayDescription.en: A 7-member knowledge-management expert team covering the full lifecycle of your knowledge base: ingest, classify, promote, index, grounded Q&A, inspection, archiving and metrics — turning scattered materials into a queryable personal knowledge library.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我还没接入自己的知识库，先用你内置的示例库给我演示一次体检：找出死链、孤儿和过期内容并给出整改清单，看完我再决定要不要接入自己的库实测。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I haven't connected my own vault yet — demo a checkup on your built-in sample vault first: find dead links, orphans and stale content with a fix list, then I'll decide whether to connect my own vault for a real run.

quickPrompts.zh: 我还没接入自己的知识库，先用你内置的示例库给我演示一次体检：找出死链、孤儿和过期内容并给出整改清单，看完我再决定要不要接入自己的库实测。
quickPrompts.en: I haven't connected my own vault yet — demo a checkup on your built-in sample vault first: find dead links, orphans and stale content with a fix list, then I'll decide whether to connect my own vault for a real run.

quickPrompts.zh: 我还没接入自己的库，先用你内置的示例库演示一次问答：处理客户投诉的标准动作是什么？逐条标注出处和置信度，看完我想接入自己的库提问。
quickPrompts.en: I haven't connected my vault yet — demo a grounded Q&A on your built-in sample vault first: what are the standard steps for handling customer complaints? Cite sources and confidence, then I'll connect my own vault to ask.

quickPrompts.zh: 我还没接入自己的库，先用你内置的示例库演示一次归档：示例库里的旧版投诉流程该如何归档并登记替代关系？看完我想接入自己的库实操。
quickPrompts.en: I haven't connected my vault yet — demo the archiving flow on your built-in sample vault first: how should the outdated complaint-handling process be archived with its replacement registered? Then I'll connect my own vault to do it for real.
